text: Updated the personal locker catalog. Desperanza has 14 viable hiding spots. Two have cup holders.
Ran a personal exit drill in the mess hall. Nobody else moved. {raider_name} logged a new record anyway.
Counted the exits. Found three. Memorized five, just in case two more appear under pressure.
Passed a locker and gave it a professional once-over. Spacious. Ventilated. Five stars. Saving it for later.
Stood in the open for a full four seconds. On purpose. {raider_name} would like this noted in the record.
Heard a noise. Cataloged it as 'probably fine' and relocated anyway. Cardio is just fear with a schedule.
Filled out a Bravery Intent Form at the Hatch Authority. Left the 'acts of heroism' section blank. Realistic.
Pod sealed. Immediate regret. {raider_name} whispered 'this is fine' in a voice that convinced no one, including the pod.
Conducted a full stash audit. Everything is essential. Especially the seventh cracked mug. That one has history.
The Pawn Desk offered 3 coins for the bent spoon. {raider_name} took the spoon home. Some things are beyond money.
Found an empty crate. Took a moment to grieve what could have been. Kept the crate's lid as a memento.
Backpack at capacity. Pockets at capacity. {raider_name} is now evaluating which items can be worn as hats.
Said 'last one' about a crate for the fourth time. The phrase has lost all legal meaning.
Picked up a bolt. Not a special bolt. But it looked lonely, and the backpack has room if you don't measure.
Sketched plans for a third shelf. The bunk doesn't fit a third shelf. The plans now include a smaller bunk.
Unconscious, {raider_name} dreamed of a warehouse with infinite shelving. Even asleep, began filling it.
Checked the surface forecast: acid rain and robot patrols. {raider_name} read it as 'free power-wash with an audience.'
Made a friend in the ration line. The friend has not confirmed the friendship. Details.
A distant alarm went off. {raider_name} assumed it was celebrating something and waved back.
Paused to appreciate the view: rubble, fog, one distant killer machine. 'You can't buy ambiance like this.'
Found half a sandwich. Declared the day 'half won.' The other half of the sandwich was never discussed again.
Woke up in recovery and rated the raid five stars: 'Would be knocked unconscious here again.'
Treated the pod safety card like a vacation brochure. Circled 'emergency exits' as 'points of interest.'
Overheard someone say the tubes are getting worse. {raider_name} gently corrected them: the tubes are getting more exciting.
Entered the mess hall dramatically. Held the pose. The Permit Choir looked up, then chose paperwork over art.
Rehearsed a farewell monologue in case tomorrow's raid goes poorly. It has three acts and an intermission.
'{raider_name} moved through the ruins,' narrated {raider_name}, aloud, in the third person, near the motion sensors.
Heard a clank and executed a slow dramatic turn. Nothing was there, which was somehow more dramatic.
Stopped in the rain, looked up, and let it hit their face for cinematic effect. Immediately got water in both boots.
Regained consciousness, checked for an audience, and briefly considered going down again for the encore.
Counted down the pod launch personally, one second ahead of the actual countdown, for dramatic tension.
Appointed a confused stranger as their understudy 'in case of tragedy.' The stranger has not accepted the role.
The vending machine hummed when {raider_name} walked past. It has never hummed for anyone else. Noted.
Checked the deployment stamp twice, then checked whether the checker needed checking. The system works.
It's quiet. Not 'peaceful' quiet. 'The chassis are holding a meeting about me specifically' quiet.
Found a perfectly good crate in a perfectly open spot. Obviously bait. Looted it anyway, but with narrowed eyes.
Spotted a bird. Or a surveillance drone doing an excellent bird impression. {raider_name} saluted it, to be safe.
Was followed for ten minutes by a set of footsteps that matched theirs exactly. Refuses to accept the obvious explanation.
Rotated sleeping cots again. A moving target sleeps better. The cot assignment desk has opened a file.
Inspected the pod for listening devices. Found a speaker. Technically correct. Filed a complaint mid-launch.
Negotiated with the ration desk for extra crackers. Offered tactical intel. The intel was about where crackers are.
Planned tomorrow's raid route based on a rumor of an intact snack aisle. The route is otherwise indefensible.
Detoured 400 meters to a vending machine. It was empty. {raider_name} paid their respects and moved on, changed.
Morale dipped, so {raider_name} checked the emergency pocket. Crumbs. Emergency crumbs. Morale restored.
Declared a tactical lunch. Tactically, it was just lunch. Strategically, it was delicious.
Found a can with no label. The correct move is to leave it. The snack-driven move is now in the backpack.
Pre-launch checklist: weapon, shield, snacks, backup snacks, decoy snacks to surrender if cornered. Ready.
Came to in recovery asking about the soup of the day. There is no soup of the day. There is barely a day.
